summary: Configure one evidence-backed I2C bus and create a HAL bus module.
requires: A validated board profile whose MCU matches the new project.
Two manual-evidenced, available board pins for SCL and SDA, including electrical pull-up constraints.
The selected MCU's local CubeMX database for the exact I2C instance, mode, pin signals, and speed parameters.
verifications: Verify the generated .ioc names the selected SCL and SDA signals.
Verify generated main.c contains the requested I2C handle, initializer, and requested clock speed before writing HAL calls.
Compile the project after module integration.
